gaps.sentence: ___ the theory is elegant, the data simply don't support it.
gaps.explanation: 'Even though' grants the fact (the theory is elegant) before contradicting it.

gaps.sentence: I know exactly what the risks are. ___, I'm going anyway.
gaps.hint: doing it in spite of risk

gaps.sentence: The delegates arrived early ___ have time to network.
gaps.explanation: 'So as to + infinitive' = in order to, a formal purpose linker.
'Firstly' opens a sequence of instructions; eventually/finally close one.

gaps.sentence: Far from resenting the changes, the staff welcomed them; ___, productivity rose.
gaps.explanation: Rising productivity is an additional point in the same direction: moreover.

gaps.sentence: ___ both parties agree, the contract can be terminated early.
gaps.explanation: 'Provided (that)' introduces the formal condition for early termination.

gaps.sentence: ___ most thrillers, the film reveals the killer in the opening scene.
gaps.explanation: 'Unlike + noun phrase' marks difference from a general category.

gaps.sentence: ___ it rains all weekend, the ceremony will still be held outdoors.
gaps.explanation: 'Even if' concedes a possible (not yet real) condition.
